cards.name: Transcend the Pendulum

effects.printed_clause: 3+ Effect Monsters including a Synchro, Fusion, or Xyz Pendulum Monster.
effects.lua_implementation: Link procedure requires all materials be Effect Monsters and subgroup-checks for a Pendulum monster also carrying Synchro/Fusion/Xyz type.

official_references.matched_structure: 3+ Effect Monster Link procedure with an additional material-property subgroup check.

effects.printed_clause: If Link Summoned: destroy all Spells/Traps, then place a Deck Pendulum and differently named face-up Extra Deck Pendulum into your Pendulum Zones; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The optional Link Summon trigger now requires at least one Spell/Trap and a legal differently named Deck/face-up Extra Deck Pendulum pair at activation. Resolution proceeds to placement only if Duel.Destroy destroys at least one card and both Pendulum Zones are then free.

official_references.matched_structure: Moving a selected Pendulum card into Pendulum/Extra mechanics with HOPT structure.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous trigger was always activatable and could perform the mandatory then-part without a successful destroy or without a legal Pendulum pair.

effects.printed_clause: Ignition: immediately after resolution Pendulum Summon Pendulum monster(s) in Defense Position; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The script creates an official-style temporary extra Pendulum Summon permission, selects scale-legal candidates, raises EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS_G_P, and then calls Duel.SpecialSummon with SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM in Defense Position, matching official Pendulum Evolution and Pendulum Encore sequencing.

official_references.matched_structure: Official immediately-after-resolution Pendulum Summon raises EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS_G_P before Duel.SpecialSummon with SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed activation/resolution legality for the destroy-then-place effect. Rejected the alleged premature Pendulum event: official Pendulum Evolution and Pendulum Encore use the same RaiseEvent-before-SpecialSummon engine sequence.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
